nodes.description: Internal view helper that computes the exchange rate from two Chainlink aggregators (multiply/divide) and a decimals scaling factor.
Address of the aggregator whose latestAnswer is multiplied into the price; supplied by the caller through oracle data.
Address of the aggregator whose latestAnswer divides the price; supplied by the caller through oracle data.
Scaling divisor applied to the final price; caller supplied.
Local accumulator starting at 1e36, multiplied by aggregator answers and finally divided by decimals.
External call to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address to read latestAnswer(); return value is cast from int256 to uint256.
External call to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address used as the price divisor source.
Unchecked division of the accumulated price by decimals; a zero decimals value reverts/aborts the oracle call.
Pure helper that ABI-encodes (multiply, divide, decimals) for use as oracle data.
Multiply aggregator address encoded into the returned data blob.
Divide aggregator address encoded into the returned data blob.
Decimals scaling value encoded into the returned data blob.
Public IOracle entry point: decodes caller-supplied data and returns the latest rate.
Raw calldata blob supplied by the caller and ABI-decoded inside get().
abi.decode of untrusted calldata into (address,address,uint256); malformed input reverts and the decoded addresses become call targets.
View variant of get() that returns the last rate without state changes.
Raw calldata blob decoded inside peek().
View entry point forwarding data to peek() to obtain a spot rate.
Raw calldata blob forwarded to peek().
Returns the constant oracle name 'Chainlink'; ignores its calldata argument.
Returns the constant oracle symbol 'LINK'; ignores its calldata argument.

edges.reason: A caller-supplied address is used directly as the target of an external call, letting the caller pick which contract is queried.
A caller-supplied address is used directly as the target of the divisor external call.
The aggregator answer (cast to uint256) is multiplied into the price accumulator.
The divisor aggregator answer is applied to the price accumulator.
The accumulated price is divided by the caller-provided decimals value.
decimals is used as the divisor with no zero check, so a zero value aborts the rate computation.
get() passes its raw calldata into the ABI decoder.
Values decoded from caller data are forwarded into _get().
peek() decodes its calldata argument to derive multiply, divide and decimals.
peekSpot() forwards its calldata to peek().

normalization_plan.reason: multiply is a non-core parameter whose only meaningful scope is the _get computation.
divide is a non-core parameter used solely inside _get.
decimals participates directly in the unchecked division operation on the price.
price is a local accumulator confined to _get.
multiply is encoded only by getDataParameter.
divide is encoded only by getDataParameter.
decimals is encoded only by getDataParameter.
the calldata blob is consumed by the ABI decode operation inside get().
the calldata blob is decoded only within peek().
the calldata blob is only forwarded by peekSpot() to peek().
